definitions.psnr: scene PSNR of D(z_hat) against the raw frame, rows 0 to 207
definitions.lpips: scene LPIPS of D(z_hat) against the raw frame
definitions.in_distribution: the same backbone on the training maps, pooled over the validation windows (the level every deficit is measured against; no reconstruction upper bound anywhere since Sep 28 night)
definitions.psnr_deficit: in-distribution scene PSNR minus zero-shot scene PSNR of the same backbone (a map's zero-shot deficit against the training maps)
definitions.lpips_rise: zero-shot scene LPIPS minus the in-distribution LPIPS of the same backbone
definitions.lpips_share_4k: (LPIPS at 0 - LPIPS at 4k) / lpips_rise, per map; the tables print the median over maps
definitions.psnr_share_4k: (PSNR at 4k - PSNR at 0) / psnr_deficit, per map; median over maps
definitions.budget: the first grid read at or below (LPIPS at 0 + in-distribution LPIPS) / 2, i.e. recovering at least half of the map's zero-shot LPIPS rise (half_lpips_rise, Rohan Sep 29 00:30); None when censored; a map whose budget is the first point of its grid is listed under budget_at_first_read
definitions.groups: terciles of the zero-shot LPIPS rise over the training maps, hardest first, split 4, 5, 4 for 13 maps

group_key: zero-shot LPIPS rise over the training maps

not_drawn.unet_full: a subset of the unseen maps: drawn on the shared panel once it covers the shared maps
